problem_type: Paid sample derivation loses request identity at a consumer
symptom: Confirming the same HD output can POST twice. A landed video cannot quote its HD tier.
direct_cause: The renderer authorized another HD locally, forced a cache miss, and priced the media type from normalization.
class_root: The sample consumer treated its output state as authority for a paid request and its transport mode.
affected_population: Creators finalizing an accepted sample or reopening its project.
entry_points: Sample row, task center retry, single node generation and frozen sample billing.
internal_only_reason: PR0 admission, the Run snapshot and the archetype transport mode are repository contracts.
invariants: One active derived order per project, connection and parent task. Completed orders require a host decision.
Price the frozen input mode and tier. Preserve provenance through recovery.

door_reduction.why_not: Single-node entry points serve distinct surfaces. Task center reads HD ownership, billing reads the frozen mode, acceptedTaskResult forwards the recipe fingerprint on receipt recovery, and the controller reads ownership only to label a host-authorized card.

generality_proof: All sample final submits use the canvas Run. Both HD price surfaces share sampleFinalPriceRequest and sampleFactsOf.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Follow host admission and pass the exact resend decision.
Read the original mode from the frozen result.
Express the derivation without forcing a new draw.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Calls confirmAndRunNode with the parent task id and selected tier.
Routes failed HD entries to the same single-node submission.

recurrence.reason: Any sample result can be reopened or selected for a second HD click.
same_class_scan: door-map of six sample symbols and callers
Inspected task center retries, the sample row and PR0 accepted-task recovery.

prevention.invariant: Use durable derived admission before authorizing another paid submit.
prevention.failure_mode: Declined consent stops the run. Missing price remains unknown.
prevention.strategy: Remove renderer admission and consume host decisions and frozen mode at their existing boundaries.

legacy_paths.rationale: Delete local second-HD admission and the forced cache miss.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The Run, cache and model contracts live in Nomi.

migration: Existing results resolve their saved archetype. Legacy videos without sample provenance keep their ordinary video behavior.
residual_risks: In-memory fingerprint cache resets on full process restart; post-restart repeat HD still requires explicit host resend confirmation via PR0.
Paid vendor verification runs once in coordinator's dedicated worktree.
